dopamine_depletion.note: Fixed from nigrostriatal and pallidosubthalamic dopamine physiology before any PD simulation: loss of D1 facilitation (-4.0 mV bias, 0.5x M1->D1 gain; Mallet et al. 2006), loss of D2 inhibition (+5.5 mV bias, 1.3x M1->D2 gain), and loss of presynaptic D2 suppression at GPe->STN GABAergic terminals (1.5x; Shen & Johnson 2000, 2005; Baufreton & Bevan 2008). Extrastriatal intrinsic parameters are untouched.

note: Pre-registered prior to Stage 4A calibration and prior to any parkinsonian simulation. Evaluates baseline_lif, Stage-2 selected_biophysics, and Stage-4A selected_rebound zero-shot without retuning.
